bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
stage="$root/.worktrees/video-ui-e60b2076"
sha="e60b2076fa5f87a58e7c7b1e3ee3706b06b1e552"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 62
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 63
docker image inspect create-videobot:poll-fresh >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
test -f "$stage/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs" && test -f "$stage/owner/gateOwner.mjs" || exit 65
docker build --pull=false --network none -t create-videobot:video-ui-e60b2076 -f - "$stage" <<'DOCKERFILE'
FROM create-videobot:poll-fresh
USER root
COPY --chown=node:node src /opt/videobot/src
COPY --chown=node:node owner /opt/videobot/owner
COPY --chown=node:node sql /opt/videobot/sql
COPY --chown=node:node web /opt/videobot/web
USER node
DOCKERFILE
docker image inspect create-videobot:video-ui-e60b2076 >/dev/null
docker run --rm --pull never --network none --read-only --entrypoint node create-videobot:video-ui-e60b2076 --check src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs
echo VIDEO_UI_IMMUTABLE_IMAGE_READY
echo VIDEO_STAGED_COMMIT="$sha"
